name: Cook's third voyage
traveler: James Cook, Charles Clerke and Mai
summary: Cook takes Mai home to Huahine, then sails north to look for a passage from the Pacific to the Atlantic. On the way he reaches Hawaiʻi, charts the coast from Oregon to Alaska and through the Bering Strait until the ice stops him. Back in Hawaiʻi he is killed at Kealakekua Bay; Clerke tries the Arctic again and dies off Kamchatka.

stops.note: The Resolution sails; the Discovery under Clerke follows.
Livestock taken on board for the islands.
Mai is brought home and settled with a house, horses and a musket.
The first Europeans known to reach Hawaiʻi.
A month among the Mowachaht; sea-otter furs bought for trinkets.
Following the coast north-west, hoping for a passage.
A wall of ice ends the search at 70°44′N.
Cook is killed in a fight on the shore.
Clerke dies of tuberculosis after a second try at the ice.
Sea-otter furs fetch huge prices in China: the start of a fur trade.
Home after four years and three months.
